tasks.label: SEMS: lint
tasks.command: ruff check custom_components/ tests/ && ruff format --check custom_components/ tests/

tasks.label: SEMS: sync Home Assistant version
tasks.command: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; version="$(sed -n "s/^homeassistant==\([^[:space:]#]*\).*$/\1/p" requirements.test.txt)"; git -C .ha-core fetch --tags origin; git -C .ha-core checkout --detach "$version"; rm -rf .ha-core/.venv; bash .devcontainer/setup.sh'
